name: Container and Directory Naming
description: Windows MDM settings in the Container and Directory Naming category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Diff Disk Parent Folder Path
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the path where difference disks will be created (when ProfileType or VHDAccessMode is configured to use them).

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\DiffDiskParentFolderPath
Type: REG_SZ

properties.name: Diff Disk Parent Folder Path
properties.description:
Specifies the path where difference disks will be created (when ProfileType or VHDAccessMode is configured to use them).

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\DiffDiskParentFolderPath
Type: REG_SZ

properties.name: Flip Flop Profile Directory Name
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

SID folder is created as %username%_%sid% instead of the default %sid%_%username%.

NOTE:
- This setting will OVERRIDE both SIDDirNameMatch and SIDDirNamePattern
- This setting has NO EFFECT when NoProfileContainingFolder is enabled
- NoProfileContainingFolder > FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName > (SIDDirNameMatch and SIDDirNamePattern)

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName
Type: DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

properties.name: Flip Flop Profile Directory Name
properties.description:
SID folder is created as %username%_%sid% instead of the default %sid%_%username%.

NOTE:
- This setting will OVERRIDE both SIDDirNameMatch and SIDDirNamePattern
- This setting has NO EFFECT when NoProfileContainingFolder is enabled
- NoProfileContainingFolder > FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName > (SIDDirNameMatch and SIDDirNamePattern)

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName
Type: DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

properties.name: No Profile Containing Folder
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

VHD(x) file is placed and used in the root VHDLocation rather than in a SID directory under VHDLocation

NOTE: This setting will override ANY OTHER setting related to container folders.

- SIDDIRNameMatch has NO EFFECT when used in conjunction with this setting.
- SIDDIRNamePattern has NO EFFECT when used in conjunction with this setting.
- FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName has NO EFFECT when used in conjunction with this setting.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\NoProfileContainingFolder
Type: DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

properties.name: No Profile Containing Folder
properties.description:
VHD(x) file is placed and used in the root VHDLocation rather than in a SID directory under VHDLocation

NOTE: This setting will override ANY OTHER setting related to container folders.

- SIDDIRNameMatch has NO EFFECT when used in conjunction with this setting.
- SIDDIRNamePattern has NO EFFECT when used in conjunction with this setting.
- FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName has NO EFFECT when used in conjunction with this setting.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\NoProfileContainingFolder
Type: DWORD
Values: 0 = Disable, 1 = Enabled

properties.name: SID Directory Name Match
properties.description:
Specifies a string pattern used when matching a Profile or ODFC container folder. Use this setting to define how FSLogix will attempt to locate a users Profile or ODFC container. FSLogix will use the VHDLocations or CCDLocations as the location where to search and this setting defines what to search.

NOTE: When using this configuration setting, be sure the SIDDIRNamePattern value matches this setting.

- This setting has NO EFFECT when FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName is enabled.
- This setting has NO EFFECT when NoProfileContainingFolder is enabled.
- NoProfileContainingFolder > FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName > SIDDirNameMatch (this setting)

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\SIDDirNameMatch
Type: REG_SZ

properties.name: Volume Type (VHD or VHDX)
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the type of virtual disk to auto-create. Default is VHD. The default is VHD which is the same as "Not Configured"

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\VolumeType
Type: REG_SZ
Values: VHD, VHDX
